scope: Post-harvest GMP processing — receiving, drying, trimming, weighing, packing, cleaning, calibration

regulators.scope: Section 22C cultivation + manufacturing licence; GMP compliance for medicinal cannabis processing

regulators.name: Good Manufacturing Practice (PIC/S aligned)
regulators.scope: Batch records, cleaning validation, equipment qualification, deviation control

audit_pain_points_observed: Cleaning logs missing dates / initials / QC sign-off
BMR sections left blank — issuance vs receipt sign-off
Balance verification not performed before weighing operations (±0.5% drift undetected)
Per-trimmer weight reconciliation gaps (issued vs returned)
Sanitizer rotation not enforced — same chemical used consecutively
Pack-out yield reconciliation (Gross → Waste → Net → Loss%) breaks chain-of-custody
Receiving Register approvals/rejections not tied to invoice match

sops.title: Outside Receiving Area · Cleaning Schedule
key_records: Date + per-task tick (✓) for each cleaning task
Tasks: walls / insect catcher / lights / ceiling / doors & handles / pallets / wipe flat surfaces / sweep & scrub floors / pass-through box
failure_modes: Daily tick missing
QC/QA sign-off blank
Same sanitizer used 2+ days running

sops.title: Receiving Register
failure_modes: Invoice mismatch but approved
Rejected items not segregated to quarantine
Receipt without signature

sops.title: Wet Material Receiving · Cleaning Schedule
key_records: Daily task tick + QC/QA sign-off (same shape as GMP-REC-01)
failure_modes: Wet residue cross-contamination if not cleaned same day

sops.title: BMR — Drying
key_records: Dual sign-off chain: Production complete → QA review → AR release
failure_modes: Conditions out of envelope > 30 min
Sign-off chain incomplete
Output weight not recorded

sops.title: Processing Dry · WMR Hallway · Cleaning Schedule
failure_modes: Hallway is shared cross-flow risk if not cleaned

sops.title: BMR — Trimming
key_records: Description · Strain · Product Code · Batch size
QA Issuance signature + Production signature + Receipt signature
failure_modes: Yield outside expected range without deviation raised
Trimmings + Flos do not reconcile to input - waste
Storage temperature breach

sops.title: Daily Trimming Weights Register
key_records: Per-trimmer row (named individuals): Issued weight / Pops / M-L / Trimmings / Sticks-Seeds / Untrimmed / Total
failure_modes: Per-trimmer issued vs returned mismatch > 5%
Row missing for any trimmer who worked the shift
Grand total doesn't reconcile to BMR-TRM input

sops.title: Trimming Room · Deep Clean Schedule
key_records: Batch No (deep clean is between batches)

Per-task tick: walls / tables-chairs-shelves / equipment / dustbins / doors / sweep+scrub floors / ceiling+lights / aircons & dehumidifiers / scissors / trimming trays / sanitizer dispensers / storage containers / sticky residue removal
Sanitizer used per surface (Steri-S residue removal with Triple Orange specifically called out)
failure_modes: Sanitizer residue not removed before next batch
Sticky residue on tables → contamination risk
Equipment not cleaned (scissors, trays)

sops.title: Wash Bay · Cleaning Schedule
failure_modes: Wash bay is decontamination point — failure compromises downstream cleanrooms

sops.title: Weighing & Pack Area · Cleaning Schedule
failure_modes: Weighing surface contamination invalidates batch weights

sops.title: Processing W-P Hallway · Cleaning Schedule
failure_modes: Hallway is cross-flow path between weighing and packing zones

sops.title: Daily Balance Verification
preconditions: Balance stabilized for at least 30 min before use
key_records: On Fail: balance taken offline + deviation raised + service call logged
failure_modes: Verification skipped on a weighing day → all batch weights from that day suspect
Out-of-limit reading without deviation
Mass pieces themselves not calibrated (annual external cal)

sops.title: ILCO Pack-outs · Master Yield Tracker
key_records: Gross Harvest incl. Waste (kg) · Waste · Waste %
Net Flower delivered to Trim Room (kg)
Untrimmed/Trimmed Wet Flower delivered to MF (kg)
Trimmings delivered to MF (kg) · Total Wet Flower delivered to MF (kg)
Difference total received vs total dispatched (kg) · Loss %
Gross Wet Flower g/plant · Net Wet Flower g/plant
Wet CN Bulk COA % · Wet Micro Bulk COA
QA Release to Loading (kg) · Flower Loaded (kg)
Dried Flower on Tray (kg) · Mass Remaining after Drying (%)
Flower issued for Hand Sort & Finishing (kg)
Hand Trimmings Collected (kg) · Hand Sorted Flower Collected (kg)
definitions: Micro < 10 g/ml on COA → recorded as 0
Micro > 10 g/ml: total = average of individual sample results
failure_modes: Loss % > 5% without deviation raised
Reject % > industry baseline (~3%) without root-cause investigation
Gross-to-Net reconciliation gap (chain-of-custody break)
QC samples not pulled from each batch

ticket_substrate_mapping.note: Each SOP execution is a Ticket. When the ticket closes, the rich row is written to its specialised model + an AuditLog entry. Same 3-layer pattern as cultivation SOPs.

next_steps: Add 4 new specialised Prisma models: ReceivingRegister, BatchManufacturingRecord, BalanceVerification, PackOutRecord
Extend CleaningInitial with `area` enum (currently has zone) covering 7 cleaning zones
Wire each SOP to spawn a Ticket on schedule (daily/batch) with assignedToRole = responsible_role
Form pages mirror paper layouts (per-task ticks for cleaning, dual sign-off for BMRs)
On submit: write specialised row + emit AuditLog + close Ticket with resolvedById
